test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: What is the theme of International Literacy Day 2025, celebrated by the Ministry of Education on 8th September 2025?

options.text: Embarking a New Era of Literacy and Innovation
Promoting Literacy in the Digital Era

solution:
The correct answer is __**Promoting Literacy in the Digital Era.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The theme for International Literacy Day 2025 was "Promoting Literacy in the Digital Era".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme highlighted the role of digital technology in promoting literacy and lifelong learning across India.**
 
• The **Ministry of Education** organized events to celebrate this theme and emphasized digital access for literacy advancement.
 
• The theme also addressed the importance of digital tools in enabling reading, writing, and numeracy skills development.
 
• The celebration included the recognition of India’s literacy progress and commitment to achieving universal literacy through digital means.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** has become the** fourth state** to achieve **full functional literacy, joining Tripura, Mizoram, and Goa** in this significant milestone.
 
• On June 24, 2024,** Ladakh** was declared the** first Union Territory **to be** fully literate.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Digital Literacy__

 __
 
• Refers to the ability to effectively and critically navigate, evaluate, and create information using a range of digital technologies.
 
 
 
• ULLAS Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram__
 __
 
• This literacy program plays a vital role in ensuring digital access to millions across the country.
 
 
 
• India’s Literacy Rate__
 
 
• India’s literacy rate has improved significantly, moving towards the vision of universal literacy and digital empowerment.
